rust_summary: a server player made invulnerable or not (`native_set_player_invulnerable`), as Bukkit's `Player.setInvulnerable` (`Abilities.invulnerable`).
doc_summary: `native_set_player_invulnerable(uuid, on)` makes a server player invulnerable or not, as Bukkit's `Player.setInvulnerable`: damage is ignored except what bypasses invulnerability (`/kill`, the void), and their client is sent its abilities. Kept until their game mode changes or they leave; creative and spectator players stay invulnerable. Bundles need "hooks": @API:set_player_invulnerable@.
